```{r}
#Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)  
library(ggpubr)   
library(dunn.test)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggtext)
library(tidyr)
library(markdown)
library(dplyr)
library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
library(cowplot)

#Colors
color_palette <- c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")
theme_set(theme_bw())

# Prepare base theme
base_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"),
    strip.text.x = element_markdown(size = 10, color = "black", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size =11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.75))


#Set the levels of the experiment
Microbes_levels<-c("MF")

Treatment_levels<-c ("Water","3OMG")
labels <- c(
  'MF' = "Microbe free"
)
```

# A] Inhibition 3OMG MF

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", fig.show='hide'}
# Load data
raw_data <- read.csv("Time_Points_Full.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#Remove D0 Rep1 which has not not work (bad germination)
raw_data <- subset(raw_data, !Bio_Rep %in% c("R0"))

# Keep only D0 as day of inoculation
raw_data_D0 <- raw_data %>%
  filter(Time_Inoc %in% c("D0"))

# Remove plants that did not grow
raw_data_D0_filtered <- subset(raw_data_D0, !No.growth %in% c("No growth"))

#Calculate median values
Median <- raw_data_D0_filtered %>%
  group_by(DAI, Concentration, Time_Inoc, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(median_value = median(Root_Length, na.rm = TRUE))

# Order factors
raw_data_D0_filtered$Concentration <- factor(raw_data_D0_filtered$Concentration,
                                             levels = c("7.5mM", "15mM"))

# Keep DAI numeric for geom_smooth
raw_data_D0_filtered$DAI <- as.numeric(raw_data_D0_filtered$DAI)

#Check normality
# Vérifier la normalité
normality_results <- raw_data_D0_filtered %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI, Treatment) %>%
  shapiro_test(Root_Length) 
normality_results # Half not normal 

# Wilcoxon tests per Concentration and DAI
wilcox_results <- raw_data_D0_filtered %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI_f = as.factor(DAI)) %>%  # group using factor version
  rstatix::wilcox_test(Root_Length ~ Treatment) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

# Find max Root_Length per group for label placement
max_y <- raw_data_D0_filtered %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI_f = as.factor(DAI)) %>%
  summarise(y.position = max(Root_Length, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)

# Merge positions with p-values
wilcox_annot <- left_join(wilcox_results, max_y, by = c("Concentration", "DAI_f"))

# Add column for plotting
wilcox_annot$Treatment <- c("Water")
wilcox_annot$Bio_Rep <- c("")

# Plot
Plot_DO <- ggplot(raw_data_D0_filtered, aes(x = DAI, y = Root_Length, color = Treatment, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Bio_Rep), alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.9,
    linewidth = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  facet_grid(
    Concentration ~ Time_Inoc,
    scales = "fixed",
    labeller = labeller(
      Time_Inoc = function(x) paste("Days of Inoculation:", x)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Days After Inoculation (DAI)",
    y = "Root Length (mm)",
    color = "Treatment",
    fill = "Treatment"
  ) +
  # Vertical lines at x = 3, 7, 14
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(3, 7, 14), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  # Stats stars
  geom_text(
    data = wilcox_annot %>% filter(p.adj <= 0.05),
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(as.character(DAI_f)), 
      y = y.position, 
      label = p.adj.signif
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 5,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  # Stats P-values
  geom_text(
    data = wilcox_annot %>% filter(p.adj <= 0.05),
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(as.character(DAI_f)), 
      y = 120, 
      label = paste0("P=", formatC(p.adj, format = "e", digits = 1))  # scientific notation, 1 sig digit
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5,
    angle = 90,   # rotate vertically
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  base_theme +
  ylim(0,130)

Plot_DO
```

# B] Time Points

## 1) Anova
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", fig.show='hide'}
#Load data
raw_data<-read.csv(file = "Time_Points_Full.csv", header = TRUE, sep=",")
raw_data

#Remove D0 Rep1 which has not weel germinated
raw_data <- subset(raw_data, !Bio_Rep %in% c("R0"))

#Remove Plants that did not germinate
raw_data <- subset(raw_data, !No.growth %in% c("No growth"))

# Calculate growth speed per plant
growth_data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    Growth_speed = Root_Length / (Time_Measurement2 - Time_Inoc2)
  )

# Subset DAI of interest and remove NA
growth_data2 <- growth_data %>%
  filter(DAI %in% c(3, 4, 7)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Growth_speed))


#Remove plant that did not grow.
growth_data2_filtered <- subset(growth_data2, !No.growth %in% c("No growth"))


# Calculate median Water growth per Time_Inoc and DAI
water_median <- growth_data2_filtered %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Water") %>%
  group_by(Concentration, Time_Inoc2, DAI) %>%
  summarise(Water_median = median(Growth_speed, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Compute log2FC for 3OMG relative to median Water
log2fc_data <- growth_data2_filtered %>%
  filter(Treatment == "3OMG") %>%
  left_join(water_median, by = c("Concentration", "Time_Inoc2", "DAI")) %>%
  mutate(log2FC = log2(Growth_speed / Water_median))

# Check normality for each Concentration × DAI × Time_Inoc group
normality_test <- log2fc_data %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI, Time_Inoc) %>%
  shapiro_test(log2FC)
print(normality_test) #Most of them are normal

# Run ANOVA per Concentration and DAI
anova_results <- log2fc_data %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI) %>%
  anova_test(log2FC ~ Time_Inoc)
print(anova_results)

# Compute Tukey post-hoc and compact letter display
letters_data <- log2fc_data %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI) %>%
  do({
    model <- aov(log2FC ~ Time_Inoc, data = .)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(model)
    cld <- multcompLetters4(model, tuk)
    tibble(Time_Inoc = names(cld$Time_Inoc$Letters),
           Letters = cld$Time_Inoc$Letters)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Merge letters for plotting
log2fc_with_letters <- left_join(log2fc_data, letters_data, 
                                 by = c("Concentration", "DAI", "Time_Inoc"))

# Add column for plotting
letters_data$Treatment <- c("3OMG")

# Order factors
log2fc_data$Concentration <- factor(log2fc_data$Concentration,
                                             levels = c("7.5mM", "15mM"))
letters_data$Concentration <- factor(letters_data$Concentration,
                                             levels = c("7.5mM", "15mM"))

# Plot with letters
plot_DAI <- ggplot(log2fc_data, aes(x = factor(Time_Inoc), y = log2FC, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Treatment, shape =Bio_Rep), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    facet_grid(
    Concentration ~ DAI,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = labeller(
      DAI = function(x) paste("Days After Inoculation:", x)
    )
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = letters_data,
    aes(x = Time_Inoc, y = max(log2fc_data$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.2, label = Letters),
    color = "black",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Day of Inoculation",
    y = "log2 Fold Change (Root growth (mm/day) : 3OMG / median Water)",
    title = ""
  ) +
  base_theme

plot_DAI
```

## 2) Wilcoxon-tests
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide", fig.show='hide'}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

# Load and clean data (same as before)
raw_data <- read.csv("Time_Points_Full.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",") %>% 
  filter(!Bio_Rep %in% c("R0")) %>%
  filter(!No.growth %in% c("No growth"))

growth_data <- raw_data %>% 
  mutate(Growth_speed = Root_Length / (Time_Measurement2 - Time_Inoc2))

growth_data2 <- growth_data %>% 
  filter(DAI %in% c(3,4,7)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Growth_speed)) %>%
  filter(!No.growth %in% c("No growth"))

# Median Water growth
water_median <- growth_data2 %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Water") %>% 
  group_by(Concentration, Time_Inoc2, DAI) %>% 
  summarise(Water_median = median(Growth_speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# log2FC
log2fc_data <- growth_data2 %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "3OMG") %>% 
  left_join(water_median, by = c("Concentration", "Time_Inoc2", "DAI")) %>% 
  mutate(log2FC = log2(Growth_speed / Water_median))

# Wilcoxon test per Concentration × DAI × Time_Inoc2
wilcox_results <- growth_data2 %>%
  filter(Treatment %in% c("Water", "3OMG")) %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI, Time_Inoc2) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Growth_speed ~ Treatment, data = cur_data())$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),  # adjust p-values
    # Stars for significance using adjusted p-values
    signif_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    # p-value label for plotting using adjusted p-values
    p_label = ifelse(p_adj < 0.05, paste0("P=", signif(p_adj, 1)), "")
  )

# Order factors
log2fc_data$Concentration <- factor(log2fc_data$Concentration, levels = c("7.5mM", "15mM"))
wilcox_results$Concentration <- factor(wilcox_results$Concentration, levels = c("7.5mM", "15mM"))

# Compute y-position for stars/p-values above each boxplot
# We can use the max of log2FC per group + a small offset
y_positions <- log2fc_data %>%
  group_by(Concentration, DAI, Time_Inoc2) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(wilcox_results, by = c("Concentration", "DAI", "Time_Inoc2")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = ymax + 0.1)  # offset

# Plot
plot_DAI <- ggplot(log2fc_data, aes(x = factor(Time_Inoc2), y = log2FC, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Treatment, shape = Bio_Rep), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  facet_grid(
    Concentration ~ DAI,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = labeller(DAI = function(x) paste("Days After Inoculation:", x))
  ) +
  # Add stars directly above boxes
  geom_text(
    data = y_positions,
    aes(x = factor(Time_Inoc2), y = y_pos+0.05, label = signif_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  # Add p-value at the top of the plot
  geom_text(
    data = y_positions,
    aes(x = factor(Time_Inoc2), y = 0.45, label = p_label, angle = 90),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Water" = "#949494", "3OMG" = "#7FC29B")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "Day of Inoculation",
    y = "log2 Fold Change (Root growth (mm/day) : 3OMG / median Water)",
    title = ""
  ) +
  base_theme +
  ylim(-0.8,0.6)

plot_DAI
```
